prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single “best” AI video ad maker — the right tool depends on what kind of ad you want, your budget, and how much customization or scale you need. Below are the best-in-class options by use case and quick recommendations so you can pick fast.

If you want a single place to start (best for most marketers)
- Canva (Video): extremely easy, tons of ad templates for social, simple AI text-to-video tools, stock assets, presets for ad sizes. Good for fast, attractive ads without learning curves. Affordable with a free tier + Pro plans.

Best for AI-generated talking-head / presenter ads
- Synthesia: realistic AI presenters and multilingual voices, great for product demos, localized ads, and scale. Enterprise-grade but pricier.
- HeyGen / Elai.io: similar to Synthesia, often slightly cheaper. Good if you want a human-like presenter without filming.

Best for repurposing long content into short social ads
- Pictory.ai: converts long videos or scripts into short clips with captions and templates — excellent for turning webinars/podcasts into multiple ad creatives.
- Vidyo.ai: automates clip extraction and vertical formatting for social.

Best for template-rich quick ad creation
- InVideo / Promo.com / Biteable: lots of ad templates, stock footage, and easy timeline editors. Good for small teams and fast turnaround.
- Promo.com focuses on ads and has marketing-oriented assets/metrics.

Best for advanced creative / generative effects
- Runway: cutting-edge AI tools (background removal, image-to-video, inpainting). Better for creators who want more creative control and novel effects.

Best for personalization & scale (enterprise)
- Idomoo / SundaySky / Twilio Segment integrations: built for personalized dynamic video at scale for large campaigns (more expensive / enterprise).

What to consider when choosing
- Output format: vertical (Reels/TikTok), square, or landscape
- Voice requirements: human voice vs AI voice, languages
- Presenter vs footage vs animation
- Scale & automation: single ad vs hundreds of variants / personalization
- Budget: free/cheap tools vs enterprise pricing
- Integrations: ad platforms, analytics, CMS
- Trial availability and export quality (resolution, watermark)

Quick recommendations
- If you want cheapest fastest route: try Canva Pro or InVideo.
- If you need AI presenters / multilingual ads: try Synthesia (or HeyGen/Elai to compare).
- If you’re repurposing webinars/podcasts into ads: try Pictory or Vidyo.ai.
- If you want creative AI effects and editing: try Runway.

Next steps
1. Tell me what kind of ad you want (talking head? animated? repurposed clip?), target platform(s), and rough budget, and I’ll recommend 2–3 tools and a workflow.
2. Try free trials of 2 tools for a simple A/B test (30–60 second ad, same script) and compare engagement/CTR once live.

Would you like a tailored recommendation if I know your use case, platforms, and budget?
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
